data.body:
[P2] Check terminal state before exhausting the retry window

With the supported `retryWindow: { seconds: 1 }`, a dead endpoint taking three seconds to return the reported 502 exhausts the window before `sendJob` invokes this `suspendCheck`. Its earlier `Date.now() + delay > deadline()` guard throws `MicrovmEndpointUnavailableError`, so GetMicrovm is never called. The default strategy still makes five delivery attempts and ultimately reports `MicrovmDeliveryError` instead of `MicrovmNotRunningError`. Ensure the terminal-state check runs before the retry-window exit when invocation time remains, preserving the invocation reserve, and add a regression covering a delayed 502 with a short window.
